metadata.title: GHULAM FAREED vs Mst. WAHEEDA and 3 others

full_text:
2020 Y L R 2180

[Sindh]

Before Nazar Akbar, J

GHULAM FAREED---Petitioner

Versus

Mst. WAHEEDA and 3 others---Respondents

C. P. No. S-1486 of 2019, decided on 24th February, 2020.

Family Courts Act (XXXV of 1964)---

----S. 7---Family Courts Rules, 1965, R. 6--- Place of
suing---Scope---Petitioner/husband assailed ex-parte judgment and decree passed
by Family Court at district 'Ka'---Respondent/wife was married in district
'Kh', her parents lived in 'Kh', the kids were born in 'Kh' and even on the
date of filing suit for maintenance they were in 'Kh'---No justification
existed to come from 'Kh' to 'Ka' to obtain ex-parte decree---Ex-parte decree
was obtained within three months---Execution was pending in 'Kh'---Judgment and
decree passed by Family Court at 'Ka' was set aside and the case was sent to
the Family Court at 'Kh' for decision afresh---Constitutional petition was
disposed of accordingly.

Israr Ahmed Abro for
Petitioner.

Javed
Ahmed Shar for Respondent No. 1.

ORDER

NAZAR
AKBAR, J.---This constitution
petition was entertained by this Court only on the ground of misuse of the
jurisdiction by the Family Judge, Malir, Karachi in which a fraud has been
committed by Respondent No.1. In fact she was married in Khairpur, her parents
still lives in Khairpur and the kids were born in Khairpur and even today they
are in Khairpur and even on the date of filing of the suit for maintenance in
2016 she was living in Khairpur. There was no justification to come from
Khairpur to Karachi to obtain ex parte decree. The suit for maintenance was
filed on 04.11.2016 and an ex parte decree was obtained within three months on
13.2.2017. After taking ex parte decree, strangely the execution is pending in
Khairpur. Learned counsel for Respondent No.1 has contended that brother of
Respondent No.1 is living in Karachi and even his CNIC carries address of
Malir, Karachi. The name and address of Respondent No.1 was not place of
residence of Respondent No.1 as is clear from the above facts. There was no
justification except to take an ex parte decree, therefore, the impugned orders
are set aside and Family Suit No.288/2016 is sent to Family Court Sobho Dero,
District Khairpur to decide the same afresh on merit after giving full
opportunity of contest to the Petitioner as he is also resident of Khairpur. In
the meanwhile, an amount of Rs.6000/- per month shall be paid by the Petitioner
to Respondent No.1 through the Family Judge, Sobho Dero, District Khairpur as
interim maintenance and the amount already deposited by the Petitioner with the
Nazir of this Court should also be transferred to the Court of Family Judge,
Sobho Dero from where along with monthly interim maintenance, this amount may
be given to Respondent No.1 and her children.

The
instant petition is disposed of in the above terms.

SA/G-9/Sindh Order
accordingly.
